card.name: Decimal point after a leading 1
card.fires_on: The decimal point right after the digit 1 in a number such as 1.5, 1.25 or 1.73, mostly in doses, volumes and body-surface values.

modes.label: Decimal after 1 in doses
modes.description: The period after a leading 1 in a dose or volume such as 1.5 g, 1.25 mg or 1.14 mL.
modes.example: In both cases, the patients were taking a 1<<.>>25 mg dose of fingolim

modes.label: Decimal after 1 in tables or ratios
modes.description: The period after 1 in a table value or body-surface figure.
modes.example: Patients with CHB The recommended PEGASYS dosage in pediatric patients for HBeAg-positive CHB is 180 mcg/1<<.>>73 m 2 × BSA
